MASVS-AUTH-1.statement: The app uses secure authentication and authorization protocols and follows the relevant best practices.

MASVS-AUTH-2.statement: The app performs local authentication securely according to the platform best practices.

MASVS-AUTH-3.statement: The app secures sensitive operations with additional authentication.

MASVS-CODE-1.statement: The app requires an up-to-date platform version.

MASVS-CODE-2.statement: The app has a mechanism for enforcing app updates.

MASVS-CODE-3.statement: The app only uses software components without known vulnerabilities.

MASVS-CODE-4.statement: The app validates and sanitizes all untrusted inputs.

MASVS-CRYPTO-1.statement: The app employs current strong cryptography and uses it according to industry best practices.

MASVS-CRYPTO-2.statement: The app performs key management according to industry best practices.

MASVS-NETWORK-1.statement: The app secures all network traffic according to the current best practices.

MASVS-NETWORK-2.statement: The app performs identity pinning for all remote endpoints under the developer's control.

MASVS-PLATFORM-1.statement: The app uses IPC mechanisms securely.

MASVS-PLATFORM-3.statement: The app uses the user interface securely.

MASVS-PRIVACY-1.statement: The app minimizes access to sensitive data and resources.

MASVS-PRIVACY-2.statement: The app prevents identification of the user.

MASVS-PRIVACY-3.statement: The app is transparent about data collection and usage.

MASVS-PRIVACY-4.statement: The app offers user control over their data.

MASVS-RESILIENCE-1.statement: The app validates the integrity of the platform.

MASVS-RESILIENCE-3.statement: The app implements anti-static analysis mechanisms.

MASVS-RESILIENCE-4.statement: The app implements anti-dynamic analysis techniques.

MASVS-STORAGE-1.statement: The app securely stores sensitive data.

MASVS-STORAGE-2.statement: The app prevents leakage of sensitive data.
